Olivia (Billing): Payment provider alerted: multiple chargebacks for merchant AdLens (acct_ADL82). Three disputes opened in 24h.
Diego (Risk): Any tie to the recent partner promo? Im seeing a spike in low-value txns and many new card BINs in the last 48h.
Olivia (Billing): Merchant flagged increased refunds and says traffic came from partner code PARTNER-9.
chargeback-bot: Auto-alert: 3 disputes opened. Evidence deadline in 9 days. Priority: medium-high.
Marta (FinOps): Placing next payout on manual hold. Also recommend pausing partner payouts until we triage.
support-bot: Merchant says: "Partner withheld postbacks; sending server logs and affiliate transaction csv."
Diego (Risk): Action items: 1) Collect affiliate attribution logs and postback timestamps; 2) Pull chargeback reason codes and any cardholder notes; 3) Gather proof of service/delivery from merchant.
Marta (FinOps): Well need ledger reconciliation for disputed transactions (ledger ids lr_1001, lr_1002, lr_1003). If representment is viable, FinOps + Legal approval required.
Olivia (Billing): Uploaded merchant and partner artifacts to /shared/finance/adlens/1914456789. Portal note: "Chargebacks open; investigating possible affiliate-driven fraud."
Diego (Risk): I'll draft a representment evidence bundle template. If merchant proves affiliate fraud, we contest. If not, escalate to legal for next steps.
Marta (FinOps): Good. Keep me posted; Ill hold reversals until evidence validated.
Olivia (Billing): Merchant replied with raw server logs and partner contact info. They've requested an expedited review.
Diego (Risk): Please ensure server logs include event ids and server-side timestamps. Ill update status within 6 hours after log review.
Marta (FinOps): Noted. If we proceed with representment, Ill prepare the accounting adjustments.
Olivia (Billing): Will loop legal if evidence is missing or conflicting.
Diego (Risk): Closing loop for now; will post final disposition after analysis.
